subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should these grouped action upgrades be accepted together across credentialed and security-sensitive workflows after the remaining Codex contract audit, or split into smaller updates for isolation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but it changes third-party code executed with repository tokens, publishing credentials, scanning permissions, and agent secrets; repository policy requires owner judgment and direct Codex-source verification.

options.title: Audit and merge together
options.body: Complete the direct Codex contract check and exact-head gates, then accept the grouped immutable pins as one routine dependency update.

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
options.body: Separate token, release, CodeQL, and Codex action changes so each sensitive workflow family can be validated and rolled back independently.

recommendation.title: Audit and merge together
recommendation.body: Complete the direct Codex contract check and exact-head gates, then accept the grouped immutable pins as one routine dependency update.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the central CI workflow and Codex-powered automation affected by the decision.
